description:
#Get Your Dream Beach Yoga Experience!

Embark on a deeply restorative yoga journey with your very own private yoga session on the beach.
					
Meet us at one of San Diego's most beautiful beaches and work with your own dedicated Yoga Teacher for class unlike any other.

Dig your toes into the sand as you stretch deep, releasing stress and stored tension. Open your heart and clear your mind with powerful breath work to sound of ocean waves in the distance.

Get ready for a one of kind yoga experience that you'll never forget!

**Ready to Book? Pick your desired date & time from the calendar and reserve your spot today!**

##Session Includes:
- 1.5-2hr Custom, Private Yoga Class with an Experienced Teacher
- Hatha Yoga, Restorative, Traditional
- Yoga on the beach!
- Soul-Charging Breath-Work
- Deep Guided Meditation
- Complimentary Yoga Mat/Blanket Rentals

##Difficulty
- All Levels Welcome

##What to Bring
- Water Bottle
- Sun Protection
- Comfy Clothes
- Good Shoes

##About Your Hosts
Vita Pura Yoga has grown from a humble living room yoga studio to a top yoga retreat and wellness company (TripAdvisor, 2022/23). Their unique combination of traditional yoga science with soulful hiking has helped thousands of students blossom and grow. Now home to a team teachers, healers and guides, they deliver specular results to students every day. If you're looking for a special spiritual experience in San Diego, you've found it.

##How It Works
We make this experience as easy as possible.  Just meet your teacher at the beach parking lot. Your teacher will have yoga mats ready to lend for the class.

##Is This Good For Groups?
This is perfect for groups of all sizes, from solo travelers to groups of 15+.  Enjoy a custom experience designed to meet your groups level, goals and needs with expert attention from our amazing teachers.

##Do I Need Past Yoga Experience?
All ages and levels are welcome, no experience required - just an open mind and desire to grow. Your teacher will customize the session based on your unique needs and level.

##What Kind of Yoga Is This?
We teach authentic, traditional Hatha yoga science.  The practice is true to its holistic Eastern roots as apposed to Western "fitness yoga".  You'll learn to move energy within the body through invigorating Pranayama (Breath Work) alongside restorative asana postures and deep meditation.  In doing so, you'll be able to release stress, trauma and old wounds, creating space for healing.

##What Do Our Clients Say?
- "I am an average yogi, my husband has no experience with yoga at all... **I am so glad I booked this, it was the highlight of our trip!**"
-Chrissy

- "**I had a truly transformational and peaceful experience** My guide led me to some amazing Breath-Work where I embodied a sense of inner peace that I have a never experienced."
-Sherri

- "Our yoga experience was incredible - the views were 10/10 as well as our session. **Can’t recommend this experience enough!!**"
-Spencer

- "The overall experience was amazing on all fronts. Reservation process was simple and communication was excellent. Reminders and meeting point GPS was provided prior to scheduled event...**and yoga was perfect.** "
-Charlie

- "Where do I start? **I booked this tour with some girlfriends and we had an amazing experience.**...he was an excellent yoga instructor. He provided modifications and a better understanding of yoga."
-Denisse

**Don't miss this once in a lifetime experience. Create a memory that won't just leave you charged, it'll leave you transformed.**
